title.en: Tao-Ting Chen · Autonomous driving and efficient inference
title.zh: 陳道亭 Tao-Ting Chen · 自動駕駛與高效推論

description.en: Ph.D. student at NYCU working on vision-language-action models for autonomous driving and real-time inference.
description.zh: 陽明交通大學博士生，研究自動駕駛的視覺-語言-動作模型與即時推論。

lede.en: Ph.D. student at NYCU. I research vision-language-action models for autonomous driving, with a focus on real-time inference.
lede.zh: 陽明交通大學博士生，研究自動駕駛的視覺-語言-動作（VLA）模型，專注於即時推論。

sim_hint.en: Simplified simulation: at higher latency the model reacts to an older position of the truck.
sim_hint.zh: 簡化模擬：延遲越高，模型依據的卡車位置越舊。

label.en: faster inference on a VLA driving model
label.zh: VLA 駕駛模型推論加速

label.en: per frame on one RTX 5060 Ti
label.zh: 單張 RTX 5060 Ti 每幀延遲
項最佳化實驗完整記錄

body.en: A fine-tuned InternVL2-1B vision-language-action model that drives a truck in Euro Truck Simulator 2 from screen pixels. I profiled each stage of the pipeline and reduced inference latency from 691 ms to 56.9 ms per frame on a single consumer GPU.
body.zh: 以微調後的 InternVL2-1B 視覺-語言-動作模型，直接從螢幕畫面駕駛《歐洲卡車模擬 2》。我逐段分析推論流程，在單張消費級 GPU 上將每幀延遲從 691 ms 降到 56.9 ms。

chart_title.en: Latency per frame after each optimization
chart_title.zh: 各項最佳化後的每幀延遲

note.en: The report also covers the approaches that did not help: INT8 and FP8 quantization, TensorRT, and a dual-GPU setup.
note.zh: 報告也記錄了沒有幫助的方法：INT8 與 FP8 量化、TensorRT，以及雙 GPU 配置。

bio.en: I am a Ph.D. student at the Institute of Computer Science and Engineering, National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University (NYCU), advised by Prof. Ching-Chun Huang.
bio.zh: 我是國立陽明交通大學資訊科學與工程研究所的博士生，指導教授為黃敬群教授。

bio.en: My research is on end-to-end planning for autonomous driving with vision-language-action models, and on making these models fast enough to run in real time on edge hardware.
bio.zh: 我研究以視覺-語言-動作模型進行端到端自動駕駛規劃，以及如何讓這類模型在邊緣裝置上達到即時推論。

bio.en: Outside research I am a maker who likes trying interesting technology with my own hands. I collect the best things I find online in Picks, and write up what I learn once I have tried them.
bio.zh: 研究之外，我也是個 Maker，喜歡親手體驗各種有趣的技術。我把在網路上看到的好東西整理在「嚴選」，玩過之後會分享心得和踩到的雷。

body.en: Open to research collaborations and AI/ML engineering roles.
body.zh: 歡迎研究合作與 AI／ML 工程職缺機會。

body.en: My entry setup for OpenAI's Parameter Golf challenge: training the best language model that fits in a 16 MB file, with an automated loop that proposes changes to the training script and keeps the ones that improve the score.
body.zh: 參加 OpenAI Parameter Golf 挑戰的實驗環境：在 16 MB 的檔案大小限制內訓練出最好的語言模型，並以自動化流程提出訓練程式的修改、保留有改善的版本。

body.en: A personal research knowledge base maintained by an LLM agent, covering autonomous driving, robotics and 3D reconstruction.
body.zh: 由 LLM 代理維護的個人研究知識庫，涵蓋自動駕駛、機器人與 3D 重建。

body.en: Reads a photographed worksheet, generates the answers, imitates a handwriting style and writes them on paper with a pen held by a modified 3D printer. Runs on a Jetson Nano without the cloud.

name.en: Brushed-metal shine from a filament 3D printer
name.zh: 用一般 3D 印表機印出拉絲金屬光澤

summary.en: A research method for printing surfaces that shine like brushed metal, whose highlights move as you tilt them, with a standard FDM printer and glossy filament. The direction of the printed lines makes the surface rough in one direction, and that direction controls how light reflects. The paper gives an algorithm that fills a shape with one continuous, closed path whose lines follow the direction you specify at every point.
summary.zh: 一個研究方法：用一般的 FDM 3D 印表機和亮面線材，印出像拉絲金屬那樣、轉個角度反光就會移動的表面。原理是擠出線的走向會讓表面在某個方向上比較粗糙，光的反射方向就跟著改變。論文提出一個演算法，用一條連續、封閉的路徑填滿形狀，並讓每一處的線條都朝你指定的方向走。

how.en: Prepare the inputs: the shape as an SVG outline, and a grayscale PNG giving the line direction at each point (brightness maps to an angle from −90° to 90°). An optional second PNG picks a mode per area: along the border, across it, smoothest, or as specified.
how.zh: 準備輸入：形狀的 SVG 外框，加一張灰階 PNG 表示每一處的線條方向（亮度對應 −90° 到 90°）。可以再加一張 PNG，替每個區域選擇模式：沿著邊界、垂直邊界、最平滑，或照指定方向。

how.en: Run the official code (Python with JAX, CPU or GPU) to generate the path as SVG and G-code. The authors report about 4 minutes for the paper's Figure 1 and about 35 minutes for all results.
how.zh: 用官方程式（Python + JAX，CPU 或 GPU 都能跑）產生路徑，輸出 SVG 和 G-code。作者表示重現論文圖 1 約需 4 分鐘，全部結果約 35 分鐘。

how.en: Print a single flat layer with glossy (silk or high-gloss) PLA. The included G-code targets a modified Creality CR-10S Pro; the authors used an extrusion factor of 0.9 and recommend a direct-drive extruder.
how.zh: 用亮面（絲綢或高光澤）PLA 印一層平板。附的 G-code 是針對改裝過的 Creality CR-10S Pro；作者使用 0.9 的擠出倍率，並建議用直接驅動擠出機。

cite.text: Xavier Chermain, Cédric Zanni, Jonàs Martínez, Pierre-Alexandre Hugron, Sylvain Lefebvre. 2023. Orientable Dense Cyclic Infill for Anisotropic Appearance Fabrication. ACM Transactions on Graphics 42(4), Article 68 (SIGGRAPH 2023).

alt.en: Four flat 3D prints in gold and blue glossy filament, a bunny, a monkey head with a QR code, a teapot and a dragon, with shading created by line direction
alt.zh: 四件金色與藍色亮面線材的平面列印：兔子、猴子頭（旁邊有 QR code）、茶壺和龍，明暗由線條方向形成

credit.en: Image: Chermain et al. 2023, from the official repository
credit.zh: 圖片：Chermain et al. 2023，取自官方程式庫

summary.en: Turns an image into disc data. After burning, the picture is visible on the surface of a CD, DVD or single-layer Blu-ray.
summary.zh: 把圖片轉成光碟資料，燒錄後在 CD、DVD 或單層藍光的盤面上就看得到圖案。

note.en: A disc is also a diffraction grating. I want to shine a laser on a burned pattern and see what it projects, then try the reverse: design the pattern from the Fourier transform of the image I want to see.
note.zh: 光碟本身也是一片繞射光柵。我想用雷射照燒出來的圖案，看它會投影出什麼；再反過來試試，從想看到的影像做傅立葉轉換，設計出要燒的圖案。

alt.en: A burned DVD-R with a pattern of small cartoon figures visible on its surface
alt.zh: 一張燒錄後的 DVD-R，盤面上看得到許多小卡通圖案

how.en: Download the release for your system from GitHub Releases: an .exe for Windows, an experimental command-line build for Linux and macOS.
how.zh: 到 GitHub Releases 下載對應系統的版本：Windows 是 .exe，Linux 和 macOS 是實驗性的命令列版本。

how.en: Create a project for CD, DVD or Blu-ray, import an image, and adjust dithering, gamma and brightness.
how.zh: 新增工程並選 CD、DVD 或藍光，匯入圖片，再調整抖動、伽馬和亮度。

how.en: Export an ISO (DVD), WAV + CUE (CD) or a Blu-ray image and burn it with ImgBurn or cdrecord. The author advises using discs you can afford to waste.
how.zh: 匯出 ISO（DVD）、WAV + CUE（CD）或藍光映像，用 ImgBurn 或 cdrecord 燒錄。作者建議先用可以報廢的空白片測試。
